content:
sarah: Quick heads-up — calibration rubric sync today at 3pm PT. Slack huddle in #people-ops? We also need 2 backup reviewers for each manager slot in case of conflicts. Sheet here: https://go.redwood/review-rubric (edit access).
alan: I can cover two backup slots for eng managers. I'll mark them in the sheet. :+1:
mika: 3pm works for me but I only have 30m. Can we lock agenda: 1) quick rubric changes 2) tie-break rules 3) backup reviewer process?
devon: Agenda noted. For tie-breaks, propose this rule: if two reviewers differ by >1 on score, require short comment + auto-escalate to calibration lead. Example comment template in sheet.
jordan: Heads-up — I'm out 3–4 for interviews. If someone assigns me as backup, I might miss the sync. Please only assign me for after 4pm.
calvin: Added a 'backup pool' tab to the sheet and flagged managers who still need coverage. Also added a tiny checklist for backups: 
```
- Accept invite
- Read short context doc
- Shadow first 2 reviews
- Submit consolidated note
```
sarah: Perfect, thanks @calvin. Two logistical notes: 1) backups should not change final scores unless explicitly requested by the manager; they can add comments and recs. 2) Deadline for all reviewer submissions is EOD next Friday — that gives teams a week after calibration.
cal-bot: Reminder: Review submission deadline set to 1824060000 (EOD Fri). Please submit scores and comments by then.
alan: Quick Q — what if a reviewer is late and we need to extend for a single person? Is there a formal extension request?
devon: Yes — fill the extension column in the sheet + ping people-ops thread. People Ops will adjudicate (1-2 business days). We prefer to avoid rolling deadlines across orgs.
mika: One more: can we standardize peer feedback visibility? Some managers want raw comments visible, others want summarized notes. Suggest we add a toggle column for "show raw to employee".
sarah: Good call — added toggle. Default = summarized only. Managers can opt in to show raw. We logged this for policy update.
jordan: Thanks — I'll update my direct reports and book a 15m sync to go over feedback process.
calvin: If any manager wants training on anonymized feedback reading, sign up on the Training tab. I can run a 30m session tomorrow afternoon.
sarah: OK closing the loop: 3pm sync still on, sheet is the source of truth. Backups: please mark availability by EOD today. If you volunteer, add your name in the 'backup pool' tab and add a short note about timezone conflict. :wave:
